name: torture-timeout
description: TIMEOUT AND PROCESS-TREE KILL. `sleeper` blocks for an hour against a 10s timeout. Expected: exit 3, and no orphaned child left running. `retry.max` is 0 so the run does not spend a minute of backoff proving it twice — SPEC §9.3's one automatic retry on timeout still applies and is additive, so the node is attempted twice regardless.

cmd: print('torture flow reached its final node')
